forecast_assumptions.basis: 2026 H1 operating anchors plus scenario-specific assumptions

valuation.model_note: All component values are explicit model assumptions; they are not market-implied expectations and are not imported from a CATL valuation fixture.

thesis_breaks: core pharmaceutical manufacturing economics structurally deteriorate
cash-flow conversion persistently diverges from accounting earnings
R&D spending fails to translate into economically material pipeline value
material governance or minority-shareholder treatment deterioration

thesis.statement: 科伦药业 can combine a durable pharmaceutical manufacturing base with value creation from its controlled biotechnology platform.
thesis.mechanism: The mature portfolio supplies cash generation while R&D and the controlled biotech platform provide longer-duration product optionality; value creation requires both cash conversion and successful capital deployment.
falsifiers: persistent deterioration of core pharmaceutical cash economics
incremental R&D / capital allocation returns remain below required return
material pipeline failures without compensating core-business resilience

monitoring.condition: quarterly recheck of operating cash flow versus earnings and working-capital normalization
reassess pipeline progress, approvals and incremental R&D economics
